definitions.gloss: livestock industry; animal husbandry (as an industry)
definitions.explanation: The industry of raising domestic animals such as cattle, pigs, and chickens for meat, milk, eggs, and other products. One branch of agriculture.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ。
examples.english: The livestock industry is thriving in this region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飼料|しりょう}→飼料：19666_shiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧迫|あっぱく}→圧迫：12013_appaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Rising feed prices are squeezing the livestock industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代々|だいだい}→代々：05899_daidai⟧{畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}み→営む：11837_itonamu⟧、⟦{乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}→乳牛：24755_nyuugyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: My family has run a livestock business for generations, raising dairy cows.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{畜産|ちくさん}→畜産：16090_chikusan⟧ (livestock raising) + {業|ぎょう} (industry, business).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ: the livestock industry is thriving
- {畜産業|ちくさんぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to run a livestock business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧: agriculture — broader; growing crops as well as raising animals
- ⟦{酪農|らくのう}→酪農：06104_rakunou⟧: dairy farming — a specific branch focused on milk-producing animals
